scripts.android: npm run build && npx cap sync android && cd android && ./gradlew bundleRelease assembleRelease
scripts.check: tsc -b && for t in calc formula notify body series tracking review import allowlist widget settings templates work timeframe notes quickfood stock pages daytabs colours moduledefs calendar reorder holidays stats ics transfer views books sharing accounts calendarlinks products units sync schedule search afterdone repeat visibility settingsui restore copy plan tasksheet hold dayitems todayprefs; do node --experimental-strip-types src/test/$t.check.mjs || exit 1; done
scripts.assets: node scripts/make-assets.mjs && npx capacitor-assets generate --android --iconBackgroundColor '#f8f4ed' --iconBackgroundColorDark '#15141b' --splashBackgroundColor '#f8f4ed' --splashBackgroundColorDark '#15141b' && npx tauri icon assets/icon-only.png -o src-tauri/icons && rm -rf src-tauri/icons/android src-tauri/icons/ios
